caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object shown from two angles—front and back views—against a plain, light-colored background. The object is a seated male figure integrated into an ornate, chair-shaped base. The man has pale skin, black hair, and is dressed in a dark blue jacket, yellow waistcoat, white shirt, and a bow tie, while his pants are brown with visible wear marks. His left hand is raised, and his right arm rests on the armrest of the chair. The chair portion of the figure is reddish-brown with decorative perforations along the sides and back. On the side of the chair, there is a circular medallion with the text "TAMMANY BANK," and the back view displays a perforated pattern with the inscription "PAT'D DEC 23, 1873" along the top edge. The figure's shoes are black. The drawing uses mostly muted tones, and the artist's name, W.O. Fletcher, is written at the bottom right corner.
title: Tammany Toy Bank
